<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="Amire80" /></noinclude><section begin=par75 />{{GHGheb|text=אַפְאֵיהֶם}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=32|verse=26}}; {{GHGheb|text=יְכַסֵּ֫ימוֹ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=140|verse=10}} {{GHGterm|Q<sup>e</sup>rê}}; {{GHGheb|text=הַכֵּ֫ינִי|translate=smite me}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=20|verse=35.37}}; cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Hb|chapter=3|verse=2}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=38|verse=16}}. Even in these examples a return to the original ending ''ay'' might be assumed; but perhaps they are merely due to a less correct {{GHGterm|plene}} writing. In the 3rd ''sing. perf. fem.'' the older form {{GHGheb|text=גָּלַת}} (see i) is always used before a ''suffix'', e.g. {{GHGheb|text=כִּלַּ֫תּוּ}} (for {{GHGheb|text=כִּלַּתְהוּ}}) {{GHGbible-ref|book=Zc|chapter=5|verse=4}}; in {{GHGterm|pause}} {{GHGheb|text=עָשָׂ֑תְנִי}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=33|verse=4}}; {{GHGheb|text=רָאָֽתְךָ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=42|verse=5|hidebook=1}}.

{{center|VI. ''The Relation between Verbs'' {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה|translate=and}} {{GHGheb|text=ל״א}}}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|75|nn}}
20. The close relation existing between verbs {{GHGheb|text=ל״א}} and {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}} is shown in Hebrew by the fact that the verbs of one class often borrow forms from the other, especially in the later writers and the poets.

{{GHGmargin-letter|75|oo}}
21. Thus there are forms of verbs {{GHGheb|text=ל״א}}—

(''a'') Which have adopted the vowels of verbs {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}}, e.g. {{GHGterm|perfect Qal}} {{GHGheb|text=כָּלִ֫אתִי|translate=I have refrained}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=119|verse=101}}; {{GHGterm|participle}} {{GHGheb|text=חוֹטֶא}} ({{GHGheb|text=חֹטֶא}}) ''sinning'', {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ec|chapter=2|verse=26}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ec|chapter=8|verse=12|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ec|chapter=9|verse=2.18|hidebook=1}}; cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=65|verse=20}}; {{GHGheb|text=מוֹצֶא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ec|chapter=7|verse=26}}; {{GHGheb|text=נשֶׁא|translate=lending}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=22|verse=2}}; ''Piʿēl perfect'' {{GHGheb|text=מִלָּא|translate=he has filled}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=51|verse=34}}; cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=9|verse=11}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Am|chapter=4|verse=2}} (where, however, the {{GHGterm|perfect Niph.}} is perhaps intended), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=89|verse=11}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=143|verse=3|hidebook=1}}; {{GHGheb|text=רִפִּ֫אתִו|translate=I heal}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=2|verse=21}}; cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=51|verse=9}}; {{GHGterm|imperfect}} {{GHGheb|text=יְגַמֶּא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=39|verse=24}}; ''Niphʿal perfect'' {{GHGheb|text=נִפְלְאַ֫תָה}} (like {{GHGheb|text=נִגְלְתֶה}}) ''it was wonderful'', {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=1|verse=26}}; ''Hiphʿîl perfect'' {{GHGheb|text=הִפְלָא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=28|verse=59}}; {{GHGheb|text=תֶחְבְּאַ֫תָה}} (not {{GHGheb|text=־אָ֫תָה}}, cf. above, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=1|verse=26}}) ''she hid'', {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jos|chapter=6|verse=17}}. On the other hand, forms like {{GHGheb|text=חֹטִאים}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=14|verse=33}}, {{GHGheb|text=קֹרִאים}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=99|verse=6}}, {{GHGheb|text=נִרְפּאוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=47|verse=8}}, {{GHGheb|text=תְּדַכּאוּנַ֫נִי}}, according to the correct reading, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=19|verse=2}} (cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=31|verse=39}} {{GHGheb|text=אֲחַטֶּ֫נָה}}), and {{GHGheb|text=יְראוּ|translate=imperative plur. masc.}} from {{GHGheb|text=יָרֵא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jos|chapter=24|verse=14}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=12|verse=24}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=34|verse=10}}, are due to the elision of the {{GHGheb|text=א}}, see {{GHGpar|74|i}}. On {{GHGheb|text=יִנָּשׂוּא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=10|verse=5}} and {{GHGheb|text=נָשׂוּא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=139|verse=20}}, see {{GHGpar|23|i}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|75|pp}}
(''b'') Forms in {{GHGheb|text=ה}}, but keeping their {{GHGheb|text=ל״א}} vowels, e.g. {{GHGterm|imperfect Qal}} {{GHGheb|text=אֶרְפָּה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=3|verse=22}}; {{GHGterm|imperative}} {{GHGheb|text=רְפָה|translate=heal thou}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=60|verse=4}}; ''Niphʿal;'' {{GHGheb|text=נֶחְבָּה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=49|verse=10}} (which must evidently be a {{GHGterm|perfect}}; read with Ewald the {{GHGterm|infinitive absolute}} {{GHGheb|text=נֶחְבֹּה}} as in verse 23), and {{GHGheb|text=הֵחָבֵה|translate=to hide oneself}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=22|verse=25}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=19|verse=11}}; ''Piʿēl imperfect'' {{GHGheb|text=יְמַלֵּה|translate=he will fill}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=8|verse=21}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|75|qq}}
(''c'') Forms entirely of a {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}} character, e.g. {{GHGterm|perfect Qal}} {{GHGheb|text=וְצֶמִת|translate=and when thou art athirst}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ru|chapter=2|verse=9}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=3|verse=8}}; {{GHGheb|text=כָּלוּ|translate=they shut up}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=6|verse=10}}; cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=25|verse=33|hidebook=1}}; {{GHGheb|text=מָלוּ|translate=they are full}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=28|verse=16}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=39|verse=26|hidebook=1}}; {{GHGterm|infinitive}} {{GHGheb|text=חֲטוֹ}} (see above, n) ''to sin'', {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=20|verse=6}} (on {{GHGheb|text=מְלֹאת}} see above, {{GHGpar|74|h}}); ''imperative sing. fem.'' {{GHGheb|text=חֲבִי}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=26|verse=20}}; {{GHGterm|imperfect}} {{GHGheb|text=יִכְלֶה}} (for {{GHGheb|text=יִכְלָא}}) ''he will keep back'', {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=23|verse=6}}; {{GHGheb|text=תִּרְפֶּ֫ינָה|translate=they heal}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=5|verse=18}}; {{GHGterm|participle}} {{GHGheb|text=בּוֹוטֶה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=12|verse=18}}; {{GHGterm|fem.}} {{GHGheb|text=יׄצָא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ec|chapter=10|verse=5}}; ''plur.'' {{GHGheb|text=צֹבֶ֫יהָ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=29|verse=7}}; {{GHGterm|participle passive}} {{GHGheb|text=נָשׂוּי}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=32|verse=1}}; {{GHGterm|Niphʿal}} {{GHGheb|text=נִרְפָּ֫תָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=51|verse=9}}; {{GHGheb|text=נִבֵּ֫יתָ|translate=thou hast prophesied}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=26|verse=9}} (cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=139|verse=14}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=18|verse=3}}); {{GHGterm|imperfect}} {{GHGheb|text=וַיֵּרָֽפוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=2|verse=22}} ({{GHGterm|infinitive}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=19|verse=11}}); ''Piʿēl imperfect'' {{GHGheb|text=וַיְרַפּוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=8|verse=11}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=31|verse=39}}; ''Hiphʿîl participle'' {{GHGheb|text=מַקְנֶה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=8|verse=3}}; ''Hithpa‛el'' {{GHGheb|text=הִתְנַבִּ֫יתָ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=10|verse=6}}; {{GHGterm|infinitive}} {{GHGheb|text=הִתְנַבּוֹת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=10|verse=13}}. For the {{GHGterm|K<sup>e</sup>thîbh}} {{GHGheb|text=להשות}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=19|verse=25}}, Jablonski and others require as {{GHGterm|Q<sup>e</sup>rê}} the form {{GHGheb|text=לְהַשְׁאוֹת}} (so {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=37|verse=26}}); the {{GHGterm|K<sup>e</sup>thîbh}} would have to be read {{GHGheb|text=לַהְשׁוֹת}}, with elision of the {{GHGheb|text=א}} and retraction of the vowel.

{{GHGmargin-letter|75|rr}}
22. On the other hand, there are forms of verbs {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}}, which wholly or in part follow the analogy of verbs {{GHGheb|text=ל״א}}, e.g. in their consonants {{GHGheb|text=אָתָא|translate=he comes}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=21|verse=12}}; {{GHGheb|text=בָּרָא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=12|verse=17}} (''textus receptus'' {{GHGheb|text=בָּרָה}}); {{GHGheb|text=וְרָצִ֫אתִי}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=43|verse=27}}; {{GHGheb|text=יִשְׂגֶּא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=8|verse=11}}; {{GHGheb|text=יִשְׁנֶא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=La|chapter=4|verse=1}}; {{GHGheb|text=וַיֶּֽחֶלֶא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 Ch|chapter=16|verse=12}}; {{GHGheb|text=תִּקְרֶ֫אנָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=1|verse=10}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=10|verse=19}}; {{GHGheb|text=תְּלֻאִים}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=28|verse=66}} (cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ho|chapter=11|verse=7}}); {{GHGheb|text=נִקְרֹא}} (''infin. absol. Niphʿal'' beside {{GHGheb|text=נִקְרֵ֫יתִי}}) {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=1|verse=6}}; {{GHGheb|text=שִׁנָּא}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=25|verse=29}}; {{GHGheb|text=מְרַפֵּא}}<section end=par75 /><noinclude>
<references/></noinclude>
